cumulative_note: cumulative = counters summed over every run that fetched rows into this file (run = the latest run only); calls count every HTTP attempt, answered = calls - rate_limited.
description: NEAR total supply and liquid-staking exchange rates at 00:00 UTC: every Monday from the first Monday on/after 2022-04-01, then every day for the 400 days before the tip's UTC date (archival JSON-RPC).
incremental_rule: Rows are append-only and never re-fetched. A run fetches only scheduled dates with no row. Rows fetched under an earlier schedule (daily dates that have since aged past the daily window) are kept. A row is written only after its block and both views answered (data or a definitive does-not-exist error), so transient failures are retried on the next run.

methods.linear_price: linear-protocol.near ft_price, args_base64 e30= (empty if the call has no answer)
methods.stnear_price: meta-pool.near get_st_near_price, args_base64 e30= (empty if the call has no answer)

sampling: Row = last block with header.timestamp_nanosec <= 00:00:00 UTC of `date` (the history_samples rule), skipping heights with no block. Today (the tip's UTC date) is never sampled, and a date is sampled only once its 00:00 is more than 10 minutes behind the tip.

schedule.weekly: Mondays from 2022-04-04 up to (not including) daily_from

search: Bracket = nearest known samples on each side (history_samples rows, dense rows, genesis, tip), excluding any sample of the same date so overlap dates are found independently. First probe = extrapolation from the lower bracket at the block rate of the known span ending there; then interpolation inside the shrinking bracket, the parent block read by hash when the answer is just below a fetched upper bracket, a doubling pad when probes stay on one side, bisection after 8.
